name: App Shell
note: Sidebar and tabs — the react-fancy shell.
thesis: The portfolio is a desktop application: a content site dressed in IDE/dashboard chrome — icon rail, project explorer, top bar, document tabs, status bar, and a ⌘K command palette — cool slate surfaces with one disciplined indigo accent and mono labels throughout.

tokens.bg: #0b0d12 page behind window; #0f1218 app body; #12151c panels; #161a23 raised; #0c0e14 chrome/rail
tokens.accent: #6366f1 indigo-500 (one accent); #818cf8 hover; #a5b4fc tint; #34d399 emerald + #fbbf24 amber for status only
tokens.fontDisplay: Geist / system sans, weight 600, letter-spacing -0.035em on display, tight line-height
tokens.fontMono: Geist Mono — used for ALL labels, eyebrows, metadata, table headers, tabs, status bar, tree, file names (.case/.md/.json)
tokens.border: 1px hairlines: #1c212c default, #2a313f hover/stronger; panels and rows separated by hairlines, never shadows
tokens.motion: 200ms ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)); hover lifts borders + a faint indigo glow; reduced-motion disables all transitions

layout: A single faux app WINDOW (rounded, hairline border, big soft drop shadow) centered at max-width 1280px. Top to bottom: a macOS-style title bar (traffic lights + window title + a ⌘K search trigger); a 3-column body grid (60px icon rail | 232px project explorer | 1fr main); a 30px status bar footer. The main column itself stacks a sticky top bar (breadcrumb + actions), a faux document-tab strip, then a scrollable content region whose sections are the actual portfolio panels (hero/overview, capabilities, featured work, full index, process, about+team, recognition, contact). Each section reads as an app panel: a mono eyebrow that looks like a filename, a heading, then dashboard-style cards/tables/tiles. The command palette overlays everything on ⌘K.

sections.name: chrome
sections.what: The app frame: title bar with traffic lights + ⌘K search, a collapsed icon rail, a project explorer tree, a status bar.
sections.restyle: Sidebar is forced to a 60px collapsed icon rail — items become 40px square icon buttons, active item gets an indigo inset bar + soft tint; group labels shrink to 8.5px mono. TreeNav recolors to a mono file-explorer with folder/file rows, selected row gets an indigo inset rail. Navbar becomes a 50px sticky top bar holding a mono breadcrumb + action buttons, all kit chrome stripped.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: Overview panel: readme-style eyebrow, big display headline with one accent word, lede, two CTAs, then a 4-up stat tile row with sparklines.
sections.restyle: Buttons flatten to crisp app chips (indigo primary with a faint glow ring; ghost = panel fill + hairline). Stat tiles are bordered dashboard cards with tabular-nums figures, mono uppercase labels, and a low-opacity indigo sparkline.

sections.name: capabilities
sections.what: Four service cards, each with an icon chip, mono number, title, body, and tag pills.
sections.restyle: Cards become flat slate panels with hairline borders and no kit shadow; hover lifts the border + a faint indigo glow. Icon sits in a 32px tinted indigo chip. Badges are mono uppercase pills.

sections.name: selected-work
sections.what: Three featured preview cards (glyph on a blueprint-grid canvas + status badge) plus a full typographic index styled as a data grid with a Pillbox filter and Pagination.
sections.restyle: Preview canvas uses a faint indigo radial + CSS grid lines masked at the top, a large glyph, and a status pill. The index is a bordered table-like grid with a mono uppercase header row, hairline row separators, stretched-link rows, and color-coded status pills (emerald shipped / amber in-build / indigo discovery).

sections.name: process
sections.what: A panel hosting Tabs (Process timeline / Principles cards / FAQ accordion).
sections.restyle: Tabs sit on a rail-colored bar; tab labels become mono uppercase with an indigo active label. Timeline + Accordion recolor to slate text + indigo accent dots and hairline separators.

sections.name: about-team
sections.what: Two columns: an about.md pull-quote + prose, and a team.json roster with avatars + presence dots.
sections.restyle: Pull-quote keeps the accent on one bold word; team rows are hover-tinted list items with Avatar presence status (online/busy/away) mapped to the app palette.

sections.name: recognition
sections.what: An awards.csv table, a clients.json pill cloud, and a press.md list.
sections.restyle: Table recolored to transparent rows on slate with a mono uppercase header and hairline rules; client pills are mono uppercase chips.

sections.name: contact
sections.what: A brief.new panel: contact details + a MoodMeter budget pad with a ReasonTag readout, beside a Composer 'new brief' card with a character Progress bar and submit/confirmation states.
sections.restyle: MoodMeter + Progress are themed to the indigo accent. Composer field goes near-black with the app fill; the card mirrors the panel treatment; the submit confirms into a 'Received' state.

palette.restyle: Forced into a 60px collapsed icon rail: items become 40px square icon buttons, active = indigo inset bar + soft tint + ring; group labels shrink to micro mono; the collapse toggle is hidden.

Becomes a mono code-editor file explorer — folder/file rows with .case/.md/.json/.ts extensions, hover tint, and an indigo inset rail on the selected node; selection is controlled state that the command palette and sidebar both drive.
A 50px sticky top bar: kit chrome stripped, Brand slot holds a mono breadcrumb (FIELDWORK / portfolio / overview), Items slot holds a status pill + ⌘K button + primary action.

The ⌘K command palette (real, keyboard-bound): slate panel, indigo focus ring, mono micro group headings, indigo-tinted active item; groups = Go to / Projects / Actions, each item scrolls to a section and selects the matching tree node.
Underline tabs on a rail-colored bar; labels become mono uppercase, active label turns indigo — reads as IDE panel tabs, not pills.
Crisp app chips: primary = solid indigo with a 1px ring + soft glow; ghost = panel fill + hairline border that turns indigo on hover; disabled drops to 0.42 opacity.
Mono uppercase pills with hairline borders; variants for accent (indigo), ok (emerald availability), and status (shipped/in-build/discovery color-coded with a leading dot).
Flat slate panels, hairline borders, zero kit shadow; hover lifts the border plus a faint indigo glow — used for stat tiles, service cards, preview cards, the tabs panel, and the brief card.
Transparent rows on slate, mono uppercase header with a stronger hairline under it, per-row hairline rules, hover tint — reads as a recognition/awards data grid.
Low-opacity indigo trend lines tucked into the overview stat tiles to give the dashboard a live feel.
Profile anchors the explorer footer; Avatar presence dots (online/busy/away) recolor to the app status palette.
All inputs go near-black with hairline borders + an indigo focus ring; MoodMeter and Progress paint in the indigo accent; Pillbox tokens render mono.
Recolored to slate text, hairline separators, indigo accent dots; Tooltip surface is a raised slate panel (portal-rendered, matched via attribute/role selectors).

contentArchetype: A small design + engineering studio's one-page portfolio (FIELDWORK): hero/overview, capabilities/services, featured + full project index, process/principles/FAQ, about + team, recognition (awards/clients/press), and a contact brief box — all reframed as documents and panels open inside the studio's own desktop app.
remix: Swap the indigo accent and slate ramp for any single-accent dark palette and the whole shell re-skins. The chrome is the reusable shell: keep Sidebar (collapsed rail) + TreeNav (explorer) + Navbar (top bar) + Command (⌘K) + status bar as a frame, and drop ANY content into the scrollable main column — a docs site, an admin dashboard, a settings app, an analytics console. Blend with 'Dark Studio' for a softer marketing read, or with a Bento/grid style by replacing the section panels with a bento card layout inside the same window chrome. The key move is treating page sections as app panels and labeling everything in mono like filenames.
